scope.domain: Additional non-browser system-quality candidates covering APIs and contracts, performance and load reliability, security verification, mobile and device behavior, accessibility mechanics, database and data correctness, CI release gates, distributed systems, and observability
scope.exclusions: Browser-framework tutorials, unit-language topics, and any intent already owned by inventory, selected topics, reserves, mining files, or intent-audit decisions
scope.selectionRule: Each survivor has a distinct searcher need, four scores of at least 8, two or more repository evidence files, verified internal routes, live official or standards-body sources, and enough honest substance for a 3,000-word article.

collisionMethod.slug: Reject exact matches and either-direction slug containment against inventory, all selected and reserve topics, all mining files, all current intent-audit rejects and replacements, and this file.
collisionMethod.title: Lowercase titles, remove punctuation and stopwords, then reject token overlap above 0.60 using shared tokens divided by the smaller token set.
collisionMethod.primaryKeyword: Reject normalized exact primary-keyword matches across every deduplication input and this file.
collisionMethod.intent: Independently reject the same searcher need even when slug and title wording differ; every survivor states what adjacent intent it excludes.
collisionMethod.publicationDepth: Retain only topics that can support 3,000 honest words from repository evidence plus standards or official product documentation.
